## Severity

<!-- Delete all but one: Critical / High / Medium / Low / Docs -->

- [ ] Critical — app unusable, data or keys at risk
- [ ] High — a core flow (pair, verify, send, receive) is broken
- [ ] Medium — a flow works but is unreliable, or CI is unreliable
- [ ] Low — cosmetic, or a minor edge case
- [ ] Docs — documentation only, no code behaviour
